title: Supabase Auth password grant with valid E2E credentials
description: POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password against the real Supabase project with {{E2E_EMAIL}} / {{E2E_PASSWORD}} and anon apikey. Assert HTTP 200, access_token and user.email. Do NOT call /admin/* on the Supabase host (those routes are the Vite SPA).

steps.description: POST {{SUPABASE_URL}}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with headers apikey={{SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}} and Content-Type application/json; body email={{E2E_EMAIL}} password={{E2E_PASSWORD}}
Verify HTTP 200 and JSON contains access_token
